services.title: Community Management
services.description:
A Telegram group isn't a community. People stick around when admins reply fast, the rules are clear, and there's a reason to keep talking.

We set up your Telegram and Discord, run the moderation, keep the content moving, and give people something to do — shaped around where your project is right now.

The goal is simple: turn joins into people who actually show up.

services.title: India Market Expansion Strategy
services.description:
India isn't one audience. People find projects through Telegram groups, YouTube, X, regional communities, and friends who vouch for them.

We look at your project, your stage, who you're trying to reach, and your budget — then pick the India channels that fit and the order to launch them in.

You get a plan you can act on, not a generic report.

services.title: Influencer & Creator Campaigns
services.description:
Follower counts don't sell anything. The right creator comes down to who their audience actually trusts, what format they post in, what language they speak, and the exact action you want people to take.

We build creator mixes across Indian crypto YouTube, X, Telegram, educators, regional voices, and community leaders. Every campaign has one job — awareness, education, launch traffic, product usage, or steady credibility.

It reads like it belongs in India, not something imported.

services.title: Ambassador Program Operations
services.description:
India has plenty of motivated Web3 advocates. Most ambassador programs still fail because they pay people to spam instead of do useful work.

We recruit and onboard the right people, hand them clear tasks, train them, set the rewards, and report back so you can see who's actually contributing and where momentum is coming from.

Ambassadors can run local content, help in the community, activate events, reach regional audiences, and open doors across ecosystems.

services.title: Partnership Development
services.description:
Web3 growth comes from relationships. The right communities, projects, launch partners, and distribution channels get you results no standalone ad campaign can.

We find and manage partnerships that fit your stage and category — collab campaigns, community swaps, ecosystem visibility, token-facing conversations, and the introductions worth making.

We check every relationship for real fit before spending your time on it.

services.title: Growth Consulting
services.description:
Sometimes what you need first is clarity. Where should the India budget go? Why is the community quiet? Which channel launches first? What does a realistic 90 days actually look like?

We give founders straight answers before they scale up spend, focused on the biggest gaps and the fastest way to get real feedback from the market.

You leave with an action plan, not a generic report.
